checklist: 用两句话复述卖方结论，复述不出来就先不要看目标价。

核对估值方法是否匹配行业：银行看 PB/ROTE，互联网看 P/S 与 FCF，周期看中周期 EV/EBITDA。
把目标价还原成隐含倍数，再和十年分位比较。
风险章节是真实情景还是模板？有没有量化下行。

A/H 同时覆盖时，两地目标价差应能被汇率、流动性、股东结构解释。
美股报告优先对 10-K 风险因素和电话会问答，而不是摘要页。
把报告当成假设生成器，而不是结论外包。

phrases.亚洲代理人网络；和平安同业不同估值尺子（EV vs P/B）。: Asia agency network; not the same valuation ruler as Ping An (EV vs P/B).
phrases.仿创结合；管线兑现比 PE 更重要，医保谈判是政策分。: Generic-to-innovative mix; pipeline conversion beats PE, NRDL is the policy score.
phrases.商业化爬坡、尚未稳定盈利；PE 无意义，应对管线和现金。: Still scaling commercial sales, not yet stably profitable; PE is meaningless — watch pipeline and cash.
phrases.减重与代谢管线定价权极强；估值贵，颠覆来自竞品和支付方。: Obesity/metabolic pipeline has extreme pricing power; rich multiple, disruption from rivals and payers.
phrases.硅片到组件周期股；产能与价格战决定利润池，不是装机量叙事。: Wafer-to-module cyclical; capacity and price wars set the profit pool, not the install narrative.
phrases.油价 + 分红；A 股流动性溢价，和美油巨头不能横比 PE。: Oil plus dividends; A-share liquidity premium — do not cross-read PE vs US majors.
phrases.南向高股息能源；产量与布伦特是主线。: Southbound high-yield energy; volumes and Brent are the plot.
phrases.美股油气对照：回购 + 上游资本纪律，和中石油不是同一套分红政治。: US oil foil: buybacks plus upstream capital discipline, not the same dividend politics as PetroChina.
phrases.水电分红机器；来水与电价，不是成长股。: Hydro dividend machine; hydrology and tariffs, not a growth stock.
phrases.成交额 + 新股 + 互联互通；本身就是 IPO 管道的收费站。: Turnover + listings + Connect; it is the toll booth on the IPO pipe.
phrases.手机 + 汽车叙事；和苹果同切片但利润池薄得多。WVR。: Phones plus car narrative; same slice as Apple with a much thinner profit pool. WVR.
phrases.美股整车对照：量、能源和机器人叙事；不要和比亚迪横比 PE。: US OEM foil: volume, energy and robot narratives; do not cross-read PE vs BYD.
phrases.广告利润池养云和模型；AI 资本开支会压近两年 FCF。: Ad profits fund cloud and models; AI capex can pinch FCF for a couple of years.
phrases.零售薄利、AWS 厚利；云资本开支与广告是近两年主变量。: Thin retail, fat AWS; cloud capex and ads are the near-term drivers.
phrases.高端宴席与礼品需求稳，大众价格带竞争更卷；几乎是纯 A 股行业。: Premium banquet/gift demand is steady; mass price bands are crowded. Almost a pure A-share industry.
phrases.全球份额向龙头集中，但资本开支与价格战会吃掉利润池。: Global share consolidates to leaders, but capex and price wars can eat the profit pool.
phrases.量还在长，价在打；利润常被补贴退坡和价格战从整车层挤走。: Volume still grows while price is fought; subsidies fading and price wars often steal OEM profit.
phrases.资产质量与净息差是主线；A 股溢价、H 股折价长期存在。: Asset quality and NIM are the plot; A-share premium and H-share discount persist.
phrases.同一银行生意，美股用另一套 PB 与利率周期，不能和中资银行横比倍数。: Same banking business, different PB and rate cycle — do not cross-read multiples vs Chinese banks.
phrases.监管从收缩走向常态化，但竞争与广告预算仍决定利润弹性。: Regulation is normalizing after the squeeze; competition and ad budgets still set earnings torque.
phrases.交易额可以很大，利润取决于补贴强度；AI 目前更多是成本项。: GMV can be huge; profit depends on subsidy intensity. AI is mostly a cost line today.
phrases.AI 资本开支驱动；出口管制与客户自制是美股/A 股共同变量。: AI capex is the driver; export controls and customer in-house silicon hit both US and A-shares.
phrases.先进制程产能是物理瓶颈；设计公司再强也要排队。: Leading-node capacity is a physical bottleneck; even strong designers wait in line.
phrases.把上游算力转租给应用；利润看定价权，风险看资本开支回落。: Re-rents upstream compute to apps; profit is pricing power, risk is capex rolling over.
phrases.硬件入口和回购机器；端侧 AI 是叙事，利润仍主要来自生态和价位。: Hardware gateway plus buybacks; on-device AI is a narrative, profit still comes from the ecosystem and ASP.
phrases.利润在临床兑现和支付方，不在故事。中美管线不能用同一 PE。: Profit is clinical conversion and payers, not the story. CN/US pipelines do not share one PE.
phrases.NBV、投资收益率和地产敞口；平安 A/H 与友邦不是同一把尺子。: NBV, investment yield and property exposure; Ping An A/H and AIA are not one ruler.
phrases.装机可以很好看，硅料和组件价格战会把利润打穿。: Installs can look great while poly and module price wars punch through profit.
phrases.油价周期 + 分红/回购纪律；三地税费和储量口径不同。: Oil cycle plus dividend/buyback discipline; tax and reserve accounting differ across the three markets.
phrases.类债券权益；电价与来水，不是科技成长。: Bond-like equity; tariffs and hydrology, not tech growth.
phrases.垄断收费站：成交、上市、互联互通；IPO 冷暖会改利润弹性。: A monopoly toll: turnover, listings, Connect; IPO weather changes earnings torque.
phrases.利润最先停在不可替代的算力和先进制程；云分成租用；应用层多数是费用项。: Profit stops first in scarce compute and leading nodes; cloud takes a rental spread; most apps are a cost line.
phrases.样本地图，不是完整产业普查。出口管制、客户自制和资本开支回落会改瓶颈位置。: A sample map, not a census. Export controls, in-house silicon and capex fade can move the bottleneck.
phrases.装车量可以很好看，利润却经常停在电池龙头而不是所有整车厂。: Installs can look great while profit stays with battery leaders, not every OEM.
phrases.价格战会把利润从下游整车挤回有成本曲线的电池层，也可能两头一起打薄。: Price wars can push profit back to cells with a cost curve — or thin both ends.
phrases.这不是上下游，是同一商业模式在两套利率、监管和估值尺子下的对照。: Not a vertical chain: the same model under two rate, regulatory and valuation rulers.
phrases.不要把招行 PB 和摩根大通 PB 直接相减当成便宜。: Do not subtract CMB PB from JPM PB and call the gap cheap.
phrases.训练/推理芯片：量价弹性最大，也是出口管制焦点。: Training/inference chips: most volume/price torque, and the export-control focus.
phrases.先进制程产能：没有它，上游设计订单无法变成货。: Leading-node capacity: without it, upstream design orders never become product.
phrases.把 GPU 时数租给模型公司，赚差价也承担折旧。: Rents GPU hours to model shops; earns the spread and owns the depreciation.
phrases.中文应用分发、广告和云；AI 能提效，但不自动变成和 GPU 一样的利润池。: Chinese distribution, ads and cloud; AI can cut costs but is not the same profit pool as GPUs.
phrases.端侧入口。硬件周期弱于算力，AI 功能更多是保住 ASP。: On-device gateway. Hardware cycle is weaker than compute; AI features mostly defend ASP.
phrases.应用层：订单很大，AI 目前主要降成本，不是单独卖算力。: Application layer: orders can be huge; AI is mostly cost-down, not selling compute.
phrases.电芯与系统：技术路线和产能利用率决定利润。: Cells and systems: chemistry and utilization set profit.
phrases.整车：量的入口，价的战场。: Vehicles: the volume door and the price battlefield.
phrases.净息差、资产质量、A/H 投资者结构。: NIM, asset quality, A/H investor mix.
phrases.美债利率、资本回报、美元流动性。: UST yields, returns on capital, USD liquidity.
phrases.化石能源分红和绿电装机不是同一利润池；公用事业吃的是电价合同。: Fossil dividends and green installs are not one profit pool; utilities eat tariff contracts.
phrases.对照切片，不是严格上下游。油价、组件价格和来水会改谁留下利润。: A comparison slice, not a strict vertical. Oil, module prices and hydrology move who keeps profit.
phrases.储量与油价：现金牛，政策与碳约束是上限。: Reserves and oil: a cash cow; policy and carbon are the ceiling.
phrases.制造环节：量的故事，价的战场。: Manufacturing: the volume story and the price battlefield.
phrases.电价与利用率：把一次能源变成可分红的现金流。: Tariffs and utilization: turn primary energy into dividend-able cash.
phrases.礼来的代谢管线和恒瑞/百济的兑现节奏不是同一估值语言。: Lilly's metabolic pipeline and Hengrui/BeiGene conversion pace are not one valuation language.
phrases.不是原料药到制剂的制造链，是三地创新药利润池对照。: Not an API-to-formulation manufacturing chain: a three-market innovative-drug profit-pool foil.
phrases.临床与支付方：真正的瓶颈是适应症和报销，不是工厂。: Clinic and payers: the real bottleneck is indication and reimbursement, not the plant.
phrases.科创板人工智能芯片设计上会样本。未上市，不能当已有代码去 Yahoo 打分。: STAR-board AI chip design hearing sample. Unlisted; do not Yahoo-score it as a ticker.
phrases.创业板过会，工业机器人+汽车客户。过会不等于定价合理。: ChiNext passed hearing; industrial robots plus auto customers. Passing is not a fair price.
phrases.科创板申购周样本。看现金跑道和适应症，不要看「医药高景气」。: STAR subscription-week sample. Watch cash runway and indications, not a 'pharma boom'.
phrases.港股 18A 风格申报样本。未盈利生物科技，南向不一定可买。: HK 18A-style filing sample. Unprofitable biotech; southbound may not apply.
phrases.已定价待上市样本。本地生活利润仍取决于补贴，不是 AI 故事。: Priced, waiting to list. Local-services profit still hinges on subsidies, not an AI story.
phrases.S-1 申报样本：租 GPU 的云中间层。利润看差价和折旧，不是「AI 必涨」。: S-1 filing sample: a GPU-rental cloud middle layer. Profit is the spread and depreciation, not 'AI must go up'.
phrases.已上市但未纳入打分样本池，用来演示「上市 ≠ 进入研究组合」。: Listed but not in the scored sample — listing is not the same as entering the research book.
phrases.用两句话复述卖方结论，复述不出来就先不要看目标价。: Restate the sell-side call in two sentences; skip the target until you can.
phrases.找出 1-2 个可证伪的关键假设（量、价、费率、市占、利率）。: Find 1–2 falsifiable assumptions (volume, price, take-rate, share, rates).
phrases.核对估值方法是否匹配行业：银行看 PB/ROTE，互联网看 P/S 与 FCF，: Check the valuation tool fits the industry: banks PB/ROTE, internet P/S and FCF, cyclicals mid-cycle EV/EBITDA.
phrases.把目标价还原成隐含倍数，再和十年分位比较。: Back out the implied multiple from the target and compare with the 10-year percentile.
phrases.风险章节是真实情景还是模板？有没有量化下行。: Is the risk section a real scenario or boilerplate? Is downside quantified?
phrases.作者近期是否连续上调/下调，以及是否同时覆盖产业链上下游。: Has the author been serial upgrading/cutting, and do they cover up- and downstream together?
phrases.港股通/北向标的要额外看资金持仓变化，而不是把资金当基本面。: For Connect names, watch holding changes; do not treat flow as fundamentals.
phrases.A/H 同时覆盖时，两地目标价差应能被汇率、流动性、股东结构解释。: If both A and H are covered, the target gap should be explained by FX, liquidity and the register.
phrases.美股报告优先对 10-K 风险因素和电话会问答，而不是摘要页。: For US names, prefer 10-K risk factors and the call Q&A over the tearsheet.
phrases.把报告当成假设生成器，而不是结论外包。: Treat the note as a hypothesis generator, not outsourced conclusions.
phrases.承销/首覆买入会降低独立权重；卖方卖出评级更稀缺: Underwriting or an initiation buy cuts independence; sell ratings are scarce
phrases.北向资金, 融资融券, 公募抱团, 产业资本增减持: Northbound, margin, mutual-fund crowding, corporate buying/selling
phrases.南向港股通, 海外主动资金, 指数再平衡: Southbound Connect, overseas active money, index rebalance
phrases.腾讯：游戏与广告修复，首次覆盖买入: Tencent: games and ads recovery, initiation at buy
phrases.招商银行 A/H：质量溢价仍在，H 股股息更有吸引力: CMB A/H: quality premium intact, H-share yield more attractive
phrases.核心结论：我们认为腾讯将重新获得游戏与广告的利润弹性。投资逻辑是国内游戏版号常态: Core view: we think Tencent regains earnings torque in games and ads. Target HK$620, 28x PE, no full sensitivity. Risks: macro, regulation, competition. Channel checks show some ad budgets returning; sample is thin.
phrases.核心结论：招行零售资产质量仍优于同业，H 股 PB 0.74x 低于 A 股。投: Core view: CMB retail asset quality still beats peers; H-share PB 0.74x is below A-shares. Thesis: NIM stabilizes, wealth fees recover, southbound keeps buying. Assumptions: NPL <1%, ROE 14–15%, payout 35%. Valuation uses PB-ROE and DDM with NIM sensitivity. Risks: property exposure, retail credit costs, wider discount if onshore money leaves. Filing shows CET1 at 13.5%.
phrases.核心结论：我们认为腾讯将重新获得游戏与广告的利润弹性。: Core view: we think Tencent regains earnings torque in games and ads.
phrases.投资逻辑是国内游戏版号常态化，广告主预算回升，以及金融科技合规后利润率修复。: Thesis: game licenses normalize, advertiser budgets recover, fintech margins heal after compliance.
phrases.关键假设包括：明年游戏收入增长 12%，广告 ASP 提升 6%，市占维持。: Key assumptions: games +12% next year, ad ASP +6%, share steady.
phrases.风险：宏观经济波动，监管再收紧，竞争加剧。: Risks: macro, regulation tightening again, competition.
phrases.渠道调研显示部分广告主预算回升，但样本有限。: Channel checks show some ad budgets returning; sample is thin.
phrases.核心结论：招行零售资产质量仍优于同业，H 股 PB 0.74x 低于 A 股。: Core view: CMB retail asset quality still beats peers; H-share PB 0.74x is below A-shares.
phrases.投资逻辑：净息差企稳、财富管理中收回升、港股通南向持续增持。: Thesis: NIM stabilizes, wealth fees recover, southbound keeps buying.
phrases.风险：房地产相关敞口恶化、零售信贷成本上升、若内地资金流出则折价扩大。: Risks: property exposure, retail credit costs, wider discount if onshore money leaves.
phrases.A 股流动性溢价，同样基本面通常更贵: A-share liquidity premium: the same fundamentals usually cost more
phrases.港股机构折价常见，安全边际相对更好: HK institutional discount is common; margin of safety is often better
phrases.港股通标的有内地增量资金: Connect names have incremental onshore money
phrases.美股信息披露完整，折现率随美债波动: US disclosure is complete; discount rates move with Treasuries
phrases.低 beta，回撤通常小于市场: Low beta; drawdowns usually smaller than the market
phrases.高 beta，仓位需要更严的回撤约束: High beta; size needs a tighter drawdown cap
phrases.beta 接近市场，趋势过滤中性: Beta near the market; trend filter is neutral
